Game Overview

In Ice Girl Rescue, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling quest in Ice Girl Rescue, where cunning strategy and quick reflexes are your allies. Use Fire Boy to vanquish fireball threats and navigate tricky obstacles like button doors and lethal lasers. With only three lives, every calculated move counts in your mission to save Ice Girl.
